subject: VIP Sponsor Bundles — ship diversion & partial fulfillment (urgent)

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: VIP sponsor bundles - production update (component backorder)

Hi Irene,

Quick update from the factory: we hit a backorder on the plated backing pins used for the enamel lapel pin component. The rest of the bundle (lanyards, embroidered cap, printed brochure, custom tissue wrap) is complete and can ship as early as Monday, Dec 14.

Options we recommend (to keep sponsor commitments intact):
- Split shipment: send completed items to the venue ahead of the pins, then send a small follow-on shipment for the pins when components arrive (ETA for pins: Dec 20).
- Substitute: ship an alternate pin variant (plain metal blank) we have in stock; quantity and look will differ slightly — I attached a photo & sample spec.
- Cancel/refund line-item for pins and issue a vendor credit.

Costs: split shipment incurs an LTL fee (~$120) and additional pallet handling; substitution is no extra fee but changes the sponsor deliverable; cancel/refund will offset by vendor credit to your PO.

Attached: goodpack_split_shipment_proposal_021.pdf with proposed packing list and estimated tracking dates.

We need a decision by EOD Friday (12/11) to meet on-site staging deadlines.

Sorry for the short notice — we can expedite replacement pins to arrive by Dec 18 with an expedite fee if you want to avoid a second delivery.

Best,
Elena Park
Operations Manager | GoodPack Co.
elena.park@goodpackco.com
+1 415-555-0123

Please confirm the following by 2pm today so I can give Elena a decision:
1) Prioritization: if we split, which SKUs must arrive on Dec 16? (I propose lanyards, brochures, VIP cards — pins can follow).
2) If we accept a plain-metal pin substitute, confirm acceptability or flag for sponsor approval (I can run a quick approval with CloudWave).
3) Budget: approve the $120 split-shipment LTL fee + any expedite fee (if we decide to avoid the second delivery).

I've attached the current event_inventory_tracker_20261210.csv for counts and what is already staged.

— Irene
